geometry_annotations.summary: Bothell assignment differs across Snohomish and King GIS polygons
geometry_annotations.text: Original HUD polygons place most of Bothell's Snohomish County portion in WA-500 in 2013–2014 and 2016, overlap WA-500 and WA-504 in 2015, and return the portion to WA-504 from 2017. These source allocation patterns are retained, with the separately recorded 2016 restoration exception. They do not create a corresponding gap in the combined Seattle metro union and do not independently establish PIT/HIC reporting scope. Counts are unchanged.

count_method_annotation.text: Snohomish County reports that 2013 HUD guidance reclassified project-based-voucher transitional housing as permanent housing, affecting reported homeless and sheltered counts. Levels from 2013 onward require caution when compared with earlier years. Retain published PIT/HIC values; do not attribute this count-method break to municipal GIS changes. Category-specific HIC effects have not been quantified here.
